description: Piano-learning and MIDI visualization desktop app with interactive chord tools, note editing, and audio export.
notes: Uses the official Electron Builder Windows portable target, not the separate NSIS installer.
The portable build detects PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR and redirects Electron userData to Orfeo-Data beside the executable. Scoop persists this directory across updates.

The portable build is distinct from the installer build. The project license is GPL-3.0 with an additional Section 7 permission for the bundled GSAP library; see LICENSE.md and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
